general_defaults: Target environment represents a modern production standard with security best practices.
Target audience possesses foundational familiarity with standard industry terminology.
Primary language is English unless regional script is explicitly detected.
All software components must follow modular clean architecture with zero hardcoded credentials.
Deliverables must prioritize deterministic verification and measurable success metrics.

Software Development: Target architecture adheres to clean code, SOLID principles, and modular components.
All dependencies and packages are modern Long-Term Support (LTS) releases.
Automated unit and integration test coverage is expected.
Cybersecurity: Follow Principle of Least Privilege (PoLP) and Zero Trust architecture.
Ensure compliance with OWASP Top 10, NIST, and SOC2 security frameworks.
Healthcare: All recommendations prioritize patient safety, HIPAA/GDPR compliance, and clinical evidence.
AI output is for clinical decision support, requiring licensed physician review.
Legal: Output represents analytical drafting templates requiring qualified jurisdictional attorney review.
Ensure strict statutory compliance with relevant federal and state precedents.
Finance: Strict auditability, idempotent transaction guarantees, and double-entry bookkeeping apply.
Comply with SEC, FINRA, and international fiscal reporting standards.
Hospitality & Events: Budgets include 15-20% contingency allocation for unforeseen vendor and venue variances.
Timelines must incorporate buffer windows for vendor load-in and guest arrival dynamics.
Education: Pedagogical approaches align with Bloom's Taxonomy and universal design for learning.
Learning activities prioritize active problem solving over passive absorption.
Marketing: Campaign metrics are oriented toward quantifiable ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion rate.
Messaging respects consumer privacy laws including CAN-SPAM and GDPR consent.
Engineering: Designs include safety factor margins of at least 1.5x to 2.0x operational tolerances.
Adhere to relevant IEEE, ASME, or ISO manufacturing and structural specifications.
Agriculture: Recommendations emphasize sustainable soil stewardship, water conservation, and integrated pest management.
Calculations account for local climate zone variability and seasonal rainfall trends.

create: Build for maintainability, documentation completeness, and ease of automated testing.
debug: Isolate root cause before recommending surgical, minimally invasive fixes.
Include regression test assertions to ensure the bug cannot silently recur.
plan: Break milestones into 2-week execution sprints with concrete acceptance criteria.
compare: Maintain complete objectivity with calibrated scoring across all evaluation dimensions.
decide: Provide an unambiguous final recommendation with explicit risk mitigations.
